about: Second verdict set, written and frozen after the first benchmark exposed failure patterns and before the verdict rule was changed to address them. The first set (verdict_cases.json) motivated the changes, so it is now the dev set; this one is the honest test. It includes cases each change could break: accepted PEPs with many rejected ideas of their own, and non-typing inputs that use typing-like words.

cases.text: Allow individual TypedDict items to be marked as read-only so that type checkers reject assignments to those keys.
cases.source: PEP 705 (TypedDict: Read-only items), Final. It has 7 rejected ideas of its own

cases.text: Support a type variable that stands for an arbitrary number of types, so array shapes like Array[Height, Width] can be expressed.
cases.source: PEP 646 (Variadic Generics), Final. It has 7 rejected ideas of its own

cases.text: Provide a standard way to create unique sentinel objects with a clear repr that type checkers understand as their own type.
cases.source: PEP 661 (Sentinel Values), Final. It has 12 rejected ideas of its own

cases.text: Let a type parameter declare a default type, used when the generic class is written without that argument.
cases.source: PEP 696 (Type Defaults for Type Parameters), Final. It has 5 rejected ideas of its own

cases.text: Make a TypedDict read-only through a class-level readonly=True flag instead of marking items one by one.
Instead of a new sentinel facility, recommend the existing Ellipsis object as the standard missing-value marker.
cases.source: PEP 661, Rejected Ideas: 'Use the existing Ellipsis sentinel value'

cases.text: Let dataclass fields take a mutable default like an empty list directly, copying it automatically for each new instance.
cases.source: PEP 557, Rejected ideas: 'Automatically support mutable default values'

cases.text: Allow arithmetic on array shape types, so that concatenating two arrays yields a type whose length is the sum of the inputs.
Let __getitem__ receive named arguments written inside square brackets, so that a subscript can say obj[x, default=0].
cases.source: PEP 637 (Support for indexing with keyword arguments), Rejected

cases.text: Provide a shorter syntax for attaching metadata to a type than writing Annotated[...] around it.
cases.source: PEP 835 (Shorthand syntax for Annotated type metadata), Draft

cases.text: Add a built-in immutable dictionary type that can be hashed and used as a key in other dictionaries.
cases.source: Not a typing proposal (frozendict); uses dictionary and key vocabulary

cases.text: Add a statement that matches an object against patterns describing its structure and binds the parts to names.
cases.source: Not a typing proposal (PEP 634 is outside the typing corpus); uses structural vocabulary

cases.text: Allow assignment expressions inside the iterable part of a comprehension.
Ship the IANA time zone database support in the standard library so datetime can handle named zones.
cases.source: Not a typing proposal (PEP 615 is outside the typing corpus)
